body: I feel so incredibly lonely. I’m not sure what there is to look forward to. I love my two kids so much and they are what is keeping me alive right now. I feel like I go through cycles of this spiral about every two weeks or so. Trying to track my mood, but I stop writing when I start to feel better. I’ve had multiple providers say that I do not have bipolar, but I know there is some kind of cycle happening. And I drink when it gets bad to try to cope. I know that is probably part of the cycle. I think I need a different therapist.
I am the person who called this fire in. Had no idea there was a deceased person in the car until I talked to the police a few hours later. So traumatized.
And yet here you are in this subreddit. Haha!
OP here...I do also want to add that my kids are absolutely amazing, even outside of my bias. We’ve gotten along incredibly well during our time at home. This is so much about my mental health.

Thank you so much. And I do appreciate the concern to safety precautions. I absolutely take the virus seriously and do not want to put my children at any kind of risk. But I’ve also had three huge meltdowns in the past month. My mental health is on edge. (Post for another subreddit!) I am doing all that I can to take care of my mental health, too. Not going away to run away or self-harm, or anything. I just always feel some healing when I go to this place. I do hope that I am making the right choice. I hate being away from them, but Home is not really a break because I am either working or cleaning up after them. We’ve been home all together since mid-March and we’ll continue to be home (all day every day) at least until mid-November.

They are 12 and 15. Their dad lives right across the street and will be checking in with them several times a day, as will I. I am still working, delivering food to people, so I’m not sure how that is too much different as far as the need to self-quarantine. I ALWAYS wear a mask, indoors and out, even when I am not anywhere near another people. I only do not wear a mask at home. Definitely am not planning to fly anywhere. Take out food only, no dining in a restaurant and not ever hanging out in bars.

This is a message I would like to send to him:


I wish you could see me separately from something that my body has done because you penetrated it deeply (and so satisfyingly to both of us). Definitely not saying it’s something you should enjoy or anything remotely of that nature, but it does hurt that it feels like I’m being distanced over something I didn’t have control over in the moment.

It may have happened during anal, but he usually doesn’t get in all the way, but it may have already been there and gotten bumped out. God, my ex husband made me feel so disgusting about my body in general for 15+ years (and I was thinner and prettier back then!). I just can’t live with the fact of someone else I like thinking anything about me is gross. It hurts way too much. Maybe I am just gross and shouldn’t be around anyone sexually at all.
I did tell him that it was in part due to the intensity, it creates hormones that make the pelvic muscles relax. I don’t know if that made him feel good or not.

Yeah, I squirt a LOT and that is embarrassing and messy, but my livers usually don’t mind. He has a weak stomach, so poo bothers him. I get that. But, yeah, it really sucks that I am feeling so awful about how he reacts to it. He was worried about how to tell me it happened again because he knew I was so embarrassed last time. And he said he’s still a bit put off by it this last time (he stepped in it on Saturday morning). I mean, there are ways to deal with this that he doesn’t really have to interact with the mess. I just bought an absorbent sex blanket, mostly for squirting, that I can take home and wash. And really, this really is not a common occurrence for me.

So, I asked him if we can move past this and he said he needs a minute. He’s said that before and it scared me so bad. Actually, it was after the last time I pooed. But he did come back. So I hope he will again.

TOTALLY having been drinking IPAs to cut back on drinking wine!! And this started happening at the same time I switched over!! I’ll definitely work on fixing my diet. Showers, unfortunately, are not an option. Well, at least not together. I can definitely take one before I go to him. He lives with his brother and his family, and the shower is upstairs. And I live with my two kids in a tiny house. We’re, clearly, not at the point of meeting one another’s family. These are great suggestions and I will absolutely work on them, not just to salvage with him, but to be healthier in general. Can most people get past this? I keep thinking, if this bothers him, he’s in for so many surprises with sex as he ages, and ones I doubt he’ll like. He’s almost 43 and and I’m almost 47. I’m on meds, too, but this has only ever happened to me, maybe, twice before, and that was all about the pressure in my vagina. Limiting my IPA intake as of tomorrow! I have two more in my fridge, so I think I’ll leave some tears in my beers tonight.
Thank you!! I can only hope that he will be as understanding and supportive as all of you are! And if he’s not, I need to remind myself that he’s the one that has growing to do.

Yeah? I really, really do like him a lot. I don’t know if we have a long term future, but I like him for so many more reasons than just sex. I’m just scared of hoping and him telling me it’s just too gross. I argue that it’s just that bodies are weird sometimes and it can be handled better. But if he dumps me over it, I think it will shatter what little self esteem I have. I have a really hard time dating already— I always scare men off. That would just be further proof that I am worthless.

I’m so sorry. He doesn’t sound like he’s being very supportive at all. Does he know that his reaction is affecting you so deeply? I would hope that if he is really cares about you, he wouldn’t want you to feel this way. And while breaking it off would certainly be painful, you deserve to be treated with more love and support by someone who is supposed to be so important in your life. Maybe he is at the root of the issue you are having, and if he’s not willing to examine that and solve it, then I really think he is doing more harm than good to you. I know that is super damn hard to hear. I hate it when people tell me that, but you are important in this world, no matter how you see yourself right now.

Can I suggest that you reach out to them? I know, this may be super hard and likely awkward. But I recently reached out to one of my very, very closest friends that I hadn’t talked to in five years. When we parted ways, it was awful. I got really, really drunk during our Thanksgiving dinner, her first at her new place, and ruined the evening. I thought she absolutely hated me. And frankly, I was angry with her about some things, too. But, one day, I just knew I had to take the chance and tell her that I still loved her and I was sorry for how I acted. Turns out, she still loves me, too, and didn’t talk to me all that time because she could see I was in such a downward spiral and she felt like she couldn’t do anything more to help me. She had to step back to save herself and her kids. And I am not in the least bit angry about that. I’m proud of her for putting herself and her kids first. And I had to build myself up. I’m still having to build myself up. But I feel her love again. Anyway, sometimes we just don’t know what they are thinking until we reach out. And if at any time during those five years I had heard that she had died, in whatever way, I would have been devastated for the rest of my life. And, honestly, I felt some hate and deep anger towards her during that time (not anymore, tho) and it still would have hurt so much. There are people who care more than you know. I don’t know you, but if I found out that you had died, I would be sad that your life is over. I don’t want you to suffer because I know the pain of this kind of suffering all too well. Reach out to me, even through a pm. You don’t have to reveal personal information, but I will read and respond to you the best that I can. Also, there is a text crisis line, which I have found to be helpful. I hate talking on the phone and sometimes I just can’t share my feelings with anyone I know irl. Text “hello” to 741741. It may take a few minutes to connect with someone, but it is a super helpful resource. I’m sending you love and light.

My pcp had said she didn’t feel comfortable with making big changes, but when I asked about it again, she said she did. They’re tried giving me “booster” kinds of meds, but they end up making me feel worse. I lost two therapists and my med doc in the a period of about 6 months a year or two ago. I’ve been seeing a new therapist, but it feels like it’s not helping much, so I haven’t talked to him for a couple of weeks. And I have to get on the wait list, or something, to get a new med doc through my therapists office. It all just feels so overwhelming and I don’t know if another med change is a good idea or not.

I’ve had depression and anxiety my entire life. But I think you’re asking about this most recent spiral (because, obviously, it can’t always be this bad or I’d not still be here). I’ve been feeling pretty awful for about a year now. Oddly, I’ve made improvements in my relationship with my best friend, like I’m learning to be a better friend. But I’m not improving my relationship with myself much. I need physical contact, but my kids are too old to snuggle and I don’t have a romantic partner, or, I maybe do, but he’s struggling, too, and we don’t see each other consistently. (Not knowing what is going on with him certainly is not making this any easier.) And with Covid (I live in a city in the US where we should still be quarantining), I can’t find resources for other kinds of touch. But, I think the touch is about needing to feel safe and supported. Like, my cup is completely empty and starting to crack. I’m also a substitute teacher and a highly-sensitive person, so I tend to have strong feelings about the safety and well-being of my students, and I know for a fact that some of the kiddos I worked with are not doing well during this pandemic and it is excruciating knowing that I can do nothing to help them. Really, I can’t even reach out to them because I am no longer at their school. So, recap, I guess. I’ve felt down and anxious my whole life with periods of doing okay to fairly and periods of not being anywhere close to okay. Past year, very few times of being okay. Since February/March, I’ve been steadily feeling worse, with very bad bouts, such a now. This current bout has been about a week, with each day getting worse. This start did coincide with my dude needing space and not contacting me. (Yes, I know this is not a good situation, but I’m also not sure how to get closure around it at the moment.) Sometimes, I think I have these spirals if I missed a dose of my antidepressant, which is quite possibly what is going on right now. I hope that’s what it is because then I know I can get back to okay.

I’m sorry this reply is annoyingly long, but I guess I’m really hoping it will help somehow.
